Error pattern: No hot water dispensing but water in grounds container
Action instructions: Clean the hot water spout,Call WMF Service (coffee dispensing possible)

Error pattern: No Choc dispensing but water in grounds container
Action instructions: Do not use Choc dispensing,Call WMF Service (coffee dispensing possible)

Error pattern: Choc portion controller blocked, Choc dispensed only with water
Action instructions: Clean portion controller,Empty powder,Turn dosing auger manually until all powder is removed,If necessary rinse with water,(Allow to) dry completely

Error pattern: Coffee dispensing on the left / right differs
Action instructions: Clean the combi spout,Care > Clean milk system manually, page 77

Error pattern: No milk foam / milk output, but milk in milk container
Action instructions: Check whether the milk hose is kinked or squashed,Re-route milk hose correctly,Basic / Easy Milk: clean the combi spout,Dynamic Milk: clean combi spout manually,Adding milk,Dynamic Milk: add milk and touch \Fill milk system\" in the customer care menu",Software > Care > Fill milk system, page 33,Basic Milk: check whether milk nozzle is blocked,Care > Milk system cleaning, page 64,Check whether milk cooler is iced
